parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.

- **desc**: descending order. This is the default value.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: TrafficTime
parameters.description: The time point of the traffic. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
